integrity: Proof supplied with exact rational six-cycle identities, analytic cycle Green function argument, and independently rerunnable symbolic checker; literature novelty remains subject to external expert scrutiny.
scientific_limitations: For cycles with seven or more vertices, only eventual nearest-neighbor loss is proved; exact positivity windows are not asserted. The result concerns completed two-stage fourth-order Gauss steps on unweighted undirected cycles, not nonlinear or stagewise positivity.
title: The six-cycle is the first cycle to lose fourth-order Gauss positivity
